children: AtlasClear reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $20.1 million, an 85% increase versus the prior year, and GAAP net income of $2.0 million, marking its second consecutive year of positive net income. The company highlighted significant growth in stock locate revenue to $6.8 million and cash more than doubled to $15.4 million. Management said correspondent onboarding and strategic transactions remain priorities as the business scales.
Total revenue: $20.1 million for fiscal 2026, up 85% from $10.9 million in fiscal 2025.
Total revenue plus interest income (non-GAAP): $21.9 million in fiscal 2026 versus $12.9 million in fiscal 2025.
Commission revenue: $9.3 million, up 56% from $5.9 million.
Net income (GAAP): $2.0 million, or $0.02 per basic and diluted share (weighted-average shares ~125.0 million).
Cash and cash equivalents: $15.4 million at June 30, 2026 (more than double the $7.5 million a year earlier).
Stock locate business expansion: stock locate revenue increased to $6.8 million from approximately $0.3 million and represented about 34% of total revenue.
Revenue mix shift: sources other than commissions accounted for ~54% of total revenue, up from ~45% in fiscal 2025.
Correspondent clearing growth: signed clearing agreements with six new correspondent broker-dealers (sixth executed after year-end) and onboarding is underway.
AtlasClearing operational strength: net capital increased 29% to $14.4 million, well above regulatory excess thresholds for clearing firms.
Strategic initiatives: continued pursuit of the Commercial Bancorp of Wyoming acquisition and evaluation of other strategic opportunities including Dawson James-related and digital asset targets.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: AtlasClear Reports FY2026 Revenue Up 85% to $20.1M, Net Income $2.0M
